draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var top = 36; var bot = 286; var rank = state.rank; var width = state.width; function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } var maxP = 16384; var scale = (bot - top) / maxP; var thr = 4000; var ythr = bot - thr * scale; var x = 48; var r = 0; var y = 0; var yp = 0; var clipped = false; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, state.w, state.h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, state.w, state.h); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); for (x = 48; x <= 560; x = x + 10) { r = (x - 48) / (560 - 48) * 16; y = r * 2 * width; yp = bot - y * scale; if (yp < top) { yp = top; clipped = true; } if (x === 48) { ctx.moveTo(x, yp); } else { ctx.lineTo(x, yp); } } ctx.stroke(); if (clipped === true) { ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("clipped", 500, top + 16); } ctx.strokeStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(48, ythr); ctx.lineTo(560, ythr); ctx.stroke(); var xr = 48 + (rank / 16) * (560 - 48); var yr = bot - (rank * 2 * width) * scale; if (yr < top) { yr = top; } ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(xr, bot); ctx.lineTo(xr, yr); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(xr, yr, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("threshold " + fmt(thr), 48, ythr - 8); ctx.fillText("rank = " + fmt(rank), 48, 318); ctx.fillText("width = " + fmt(width), 300, 318); ctx.fillText("toy", 48, 344); }
